name: Popper
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 4, line cook 4

Flavor Profiles spicy, salty, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients sour, sweet, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1d6+2

DESCRIPTION

When complete, you can throw one serving of poppers as an alchemist’s fire that deals 4d6 initial fire damage and 2d6 burn damage to the initial target, and 4 splash damage to every creature within 5 feet of the point where the popper hits.

When consumed, it removes all negative emotional effects if their level is equal to or lower than the complexity of the popper. Effects without their own level use half the total Hit Dice of the creature that created them instead.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size and effective complexity of the popper by +1 each. The initial fire damage also increases by +1d6, and the splash damage increases by +1.

Additional sour ingredients allow the popper to deal acid damage instead.
